words.definition: the usual weather in a place over a long time

words.definition: things that are thrown away because they are not needed

words.definition: how hot or cold something is
words.example: The temperature in the city is rising every year.

text: Our planet needs our help. Every day, people produce a lot of waste, and some of it becomes litter in rivers, forests, and cities. This is a big problem for the environment. Plastic is one of the biggest causes of pollution because it takes a very long time to disappear. When factories pollute rivers and the air, it can hurt plants, animals, and people too. Scientists also say that the Earth's climate is changing, and the temperature is going up around the world. This can change the weather in many countries and make life hard for animals in the forest and the sea. But there are simple things we can all do to protect our natural resources. We can reduce the plastic we use, reuse bags and bottles, and recycle paper and glass instead of throwing them away. Clean energy from the sun and wind can also help instead of using resources that harm the planet. Small actions from every person can make a big difference. If we all try, we can keep our planet clean and safe for the future.
